effect.name: GM Flow Smear
effect.desc: Image-gradient-driven paint flow that follows local contours instead of using a fixed blur direction.
effect.shader: float l(vec2 p){return dot(texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(p,0.0,1.0)).rgb,vec3(.2126,.7152,.0722));}void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm,sz=max(inputImg.size,vec2(1.0)),e=1.0/sz;vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,uv);vec2 grad=vec2(l(uv+vec2(e.x,0))-l(uv-vec2(e.x,0)),l(uv+vec2(0,e.y))-l(uv-vec2(0,e.y)));float edge=length(grad);vec2 dir=normalize(vec2(-grad.y,grad.x)+vec2(.0001));vec4 sum=vec4(0);float ws=0.0,count=clamp(floor(samples+.5),4.0,24.0);for(int i=0;i<24;i++){if(float(i)>=count)break;float t=float(i)/max(count-1.0,1.0)-.5;vec2 bend=vec2(-dir.y,dir.x)*curvature*t*t;float w=1.0-abs(t);sum+=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(uv+(dir*t+bend)*lengthPx/sz,0.0,1.0))*w;ws+=w;}float mask=smoothstep(edgeThreshold,edgeThreshold*3.0+.001,edge)*(1.0-detail);gl_FragColor=mix(src,sum/max(ws,.001),mixAmount*mask);}
